text:
marta: Vendor sent updated price sheet for 'Pro Assist' (price_id=PS-2026-PA-03). Need quick ops + finance review before any shadow. Link: https://vendor.example.com/sheets/PS-2026-PA-03
liam: Does this touch reserved commits or just PAYG?
sophia: Also preserve coupon mappings for legacy customers, please.
marta: PAYG only; reserved unaffected. It will change invoice template v2 line item and token tier.
devin: Found three edge cases in mapping CSV: percent coupons, manual-invoice accounts, metered-overage flags. Snippet: ```acct_id,legacy_flag,apply_new_price
12345,true,false
67890,false,true```
marta: @billing-bot run preview for cohort "price-exp-proassist" (~10k accounts). Return invoice deltas + coupon collisions.
billing-bot: Preview queued job_id=jb_7001. ETA ~10m.
liam: Vendor also added a termination clause. Legal need to sign off?
cara: Legal flagged it; vendor asked to remove. Not blocking PAYG canary.
marta: Rollout plan: canary 1% PAYG, shadow reserved. A/B: A baseline (10k), B new price (10k). @sophia please stratify cohorts by revenue decile.
sophia: On it. ETA ~2h.
billing-bot: job complete. jb_7001 summary: cohort_B median invoice +2.1%, coupon collisions 0.09%, anomalies: 18 accounts with >$1k negative delta (proration issue). Report: https://internal/reports/jb_7001
devin: I'll prepare a hotfix to translation table to correct proration. Need approval to run in canary first.
marta: Approved to patch in canary, validate, then promote. Abort if coupon collisions >0.5% or >100 accounts >$1k delta.
sophia: If hotfix passes, target 1% canary tomorrow 09:00 PT.
marta: I'll post runbook in #release-war-room and notify Sales for comms. Keep updates here.
